target_pattern: Use ojala with present subjunctive for realistic hopes and with imperfect subjunctive for unlikely or hypothetical wishes.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Using one single I hope or I wish structure without changing mood by meaning.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Ojala always triggers subjunctive, but the tense choice signals whether the outcome is plausible or hypothetical.
target_pattern_formula: ojala que plus present subjunctive for likely present or near-future outcomes
ojala que plus imperfect subjunctive for unlikely or unreal wishes
common pair contrasts: haya versus hubiera, pueda versus pudiera, este versus estuviera

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Ojala no haya mucho trafico. -> change noun to ruido.
Base: Ojala haya una mesa en la sombra. -> change location to la terraza.
Base: Ojala tengamos tiempo para descansar. -> change infinitive to comer.
Base: Ojala puedas venir esta noche. -> change subject to plural ustedes.
Base: Ojala lleguen a tiempo. -> change tense meaning to unlikely wish.
Base: Ojala no llueva manana. -> change weather verb to hacer frio.
Base: Ojala mi jefe entienda la situacion. -> change subject to mis clientes.
Base: Ojala encontremos una solucion hoy. -> change object to plural soluciones.
Base: Ojala haya suficiente cafe. -> change noun to agua.
Base: Ojala se mejore pronto. -> change to plural subject.
Base: Ojala tuviera mas tiempo. -> change noun to dinero.
Base: Ojala pudiera ayudarte. -> change recipient to plural ustedes.
Base: Ojala estuvieras aqui. -> change pronoun to ellos.
Base: Ojala hubiera menos gente. -> change quantity to mas.
Base: Ojala vivieramos mas cerca. -> change place idea to el mar.

I hope they arrive on time. (Ojala lleguen a tiempo. vs Ojala llegaran a tiempo.)
I wish they arrived on time. (Ojala llegaran a tiempo. vs Ojala lleguen a tiempo.)

common_errors.why_it_happens: Ojala treated as a regular adverb without mood trigger.

common_errors.mistake: Present subjunctive used for impossible wish
common_errors.why_it_happens: No distinction between likely hope and unreal wish.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use imperfect subjunctive for unlikely or hypothetical wishes.

common_errors.mistake: Imperfect subjunctive used for realistic near-future hope
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use present subjunctive for plausible outcomes.

common_errors.mistake: Believing que is mandatory after ojala

common_errors.why_it_happens: Future meaning interpreted as future morphology.

common_errors.mistake: ojala pudiera for likely can meaning
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use ojala pueda for likely hope.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Forms look similar and both come from haber.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Choose by realistic hope versus unreal wish meaning.

common_errors.mistake: Literal translation with deseo instead of ojala in these frames
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use ojala patterns for this type of wish expression.

common_errors.mistake: Explicit subject pronouns in every ojala clause
common_errors.correct_spanish: Omit pronouns when context is clear.

common_errors.mistake: Avoiding ojala due to subjunctive anxiety
common_errors.correct_spanish: Apply simple two-way split: likely hope vs unreal wish.
